verdict.rationale: User-configurable background automation, such as scheduled or recurring transfers or rule-based triggers, is a fair question for a developer banking platform, but the evidence documents none. Webhooks [column-docs-7] and idempotency [column-docs-22] are developer building blocks. Auto-generated monthly statements [column-docs-21] are fixed product behavior, not automations a user sets up. Sweep is listed only as an account type [column-docs-2], with no documented automation rules.
